differences.what: B shows heavy denoiser/upscale smearing: painterly blotches on the driver cones, frame struts and acrylic edges, soft melted outlines on the horns; A's edges and internal struts stay crisp

B's hard sun throws long coloured transmissive shadows and caustic pools on the floor, a striking graphic element that sells the tinted clear; A's shadows are soft, short and nearly colourless, so the floor reads empty

A's soft gradient backdrop and even wraparound light give a calm, premium homepage set with the row evenly spaced on an arc; B's flat grey wall and crowded, overlapping row with wide-angle stretching look less composed
B's harder light gives the horns and acrylic stronger specular rims and more saturated, glassy colour; A's tints read slightly milky and low in contrast
Black unit at far right: in A it nearly vanishes into a dark mass with little edge definition; B separates it a bit better against the light wall but still lacks a rim light
